python3 -c "
import subprocess, json, sys
# Check if any CC files are staged
r = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--name-only'], capture_output=True, text=True)
staged = r.stdout.strip()
if 'brain/command_centre/' in staged:
    # Run help check
    h = subprocess.run(['python3', '-m', 'brain.command_centre.help_gen', '--check'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if h.returncode != 0:
        print(json.dumps({'decision': 'block', 'reason': 'STOP: CC files are staged but help outputs are stale. Run: python3 -m brain.command_centre.help_gen'}))
        sys.exit(0)
    # Run tests
    t = subprocess.run(['python3', '-m', 'pytest', 'brain/tests/test_command_centre/', '-x', '-q'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if t.returncode != 0:
        print(json.dumps({'decision': 'block', 'reason': 'STOP: CC tests are failing. Fix before finishing:\n' + t.stdout}))
        sys.exit(0)
print(json.dumps({}))
"
